INSERT INTO users_subscriptions (
                id, user_id, price_id, interval, created, status
            )
            VALUES (
                $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6
            )
            ON CONFLICT (id)
            DO UPDATE
                SET interval = EXCLUDED.interval,
                    status = EXCLUDED.status,
                    price_id = EXCLUDED.price_id
